notes: Previous source U confidence and near saturation motivate this measurement; no target score selects mechanism or parameters.
Cross-RX SupCon, feature mixing, conditional teachers and graph anchors already exist; this diagnostic measures a separate probability versus representation consistency gap.
Centered cosine-head rowspace partition is an exact diagnostic in normalized feature coordinates, not a new global orthogonality loss or claim that residual dimensions contain only nuisance.
Raw losses have different units. Gradient norm ratios describe scale, not useful update direction or improvement. No automatic loss weighting fitted.
Two views reuse prior fixed .015 noise and L-derived33tap ±3dB physical action bank. Physical actions are bounded proxies, not proved label-preserving receiver transformations.
Current batch0 identity updates. Future actual continuation remains matching originalE200,40epochs3seeds;84%target unchanged.
